data.name: Radial Overdrive
data.detailed_description:
Radial Overdrive is a retro-futuristic, endless racing rogue-lite where speed isn’t just a thrill, it’s survival. Set in a massive city controlled by large corporations, this hovercraft racing game takes you through the different parts of the city and shows you what life might be like in a couple hundred years.

With wealth disparity increased dramatically, it is clear there is a stark contrast between the rich and poor. The lower levels are gritty, claustrophobic and dark, while the top levels are luxurious, beautiful and colorful! The Radial Overdrive race is organized by the rich for their entertainment, so you better make an interesting show as your life is literally in the hands of the 1%.

Radial Overdrive is a thrilling blend of high-speed racing and rogue-lite challenges, where every run is unique, and every decision matters. Will you master the art of speed and rise to the top, or will you join the graveyard of fallen racers? Strap in and find out.

Steam Deck compatible

data.short_description: Strap in, hotshot! Welcome to Radial Overdrive! Weave through the city of opportunity and style in your state-of-the-art high-speed hovercraft. Upgrade your vehicle to keep those turns smooth and nerves loose. Push the limits of what's possible in this endless racing rogue-lite!
